description: This file defines the `OrderSetAttributeType` class, which extends `BaseAttributeType<OrderSet>` and implements `AttributeType<OrderSet>`. It is a part of the OpenMRS project, specifically an extension related to the OrderSet functionality, including getter and setter methods for the attribute type ID. The class is annotated with @Audited for audit purposes.

classes.name: OrderSetAttributeType
classes.description: A user-defined extension to the OrderSet class, representing attribute type metadata with an ID field and standard getter/setter methods.

methods.description: Sets the identifier of the OrderSetAttributeType.
